metadata.question: Does the land surface temperature in Taipei,Taiwan decrease in January 17-24, 2016 compared to the 2001-2010 average for the same period?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy:
   - Collection: MODIS Terra Daytime LST (MODIS/061/MOD11A1); fallback to MODIS Aqua Daytime LST (MODIS/061/MYD11A1).
   - Dates: Jan 17–24 (inclusive) for 2016 and for each year 2001–2010 (end date set to Jan 25 exclusive).
   - Location: Taipei, Taiwan approximated by a 15 km buffer around 25.0330N, 121.5654E.

2. Masking strategy:
   - Apply QC mask: keep pixels with QC_Day bits 0–1 < 2 (LST produced, good/other quality).
   - Convert LST to Celsius: LST_Day_1km*0.02 - 273.15.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error:
   - Check collection size; if 0, try fallback product; if still 0, output C1.
   - After masking, compute valid pixel counts; if 0, output C2.
   - Validate means are not null and within [-80, 80] C; else C3.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function getInfoAsync(obj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.getInfo((res, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(res);
    });
  });
}

function maskMOD11A1(img) {
  var qa = img.select('QC_Day');
  // Keep pixels where bits 0-1 < 2 (00 or 01): LST produced
  var mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).lt(2);
  var lstC = img.select('LST_Day_1km')
      .updateMask(mask)
      .multiply(0.02)
      .subtract(273.15)
      .rename('LSTC');
  return lstC.copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
}

function getCol(productId, start, end, geom) {
  return ee.ImageCollection(productId)
    .filterBounds(geom)
    .filterDate(start, end)
    .map(maskMOD11A1);
}

async function chooseColWithFallback(start, end, geom) {
  let primaryId = 'MODIS/061/MOD11A1';
  let fallbackId = 'MODIS/061/MYD11A1';
  let col1 = getCol(primaryId, start, end, geom);
  let n1 = await getInfoAsync(col1.size());
  if (n1 > 0) return {col: col1, id: primaryId, size: n1};
  let col2 = getCol(fallbackId, start, end, geom);
  let n2 = await getInfoAsync(col2.size());
  return {col: col2, id: fallbackId, size: n2};
}

async function regionStats(image, geom) {
  const scale = 1000;
  const meanDict = image.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e9,
    bestEffort: true
  });
  const countValidDict = image.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e9,
    bestEffort: true
  });
  const totalDict = ee.Image(1).rename('const').reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: geom,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e9,
    bestEffort: true
  });

  let mean = await getInfoAsync(meanDict.get('LSTC'));
  let valid = await getInfoAsync(countValidDict.get('LSTC'));
  let total = await getInfoAsync(totalDict.get('const'));

  let pct = (valid && total) ? (100.0 * valid / total) : 0;
  return {mean: mean, valid: valid || 0, total: total || 0, pct: pct};
}

function fmt(n, digits=2) {
  if (n === null || n === undefined || isNaN(n)) return 'NaN';
  return Number(n).toFixed(digits);
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const taipeiPt = ee.Geometry.Point([121.5654, 25.0330]);
    const region = taipeiPt.buffer(15000).bounds(); // ~15 km buffer box

    const start2016 = '2016-01-17';
    const end2016 = '2016-01-25'; // end exclusive

    // 2. 2016 data with fallback
    let chosen2016 = await chooseColWithFallback(start2016, end2016, region);
    if (chosen2016.size === 0) {
      console.log('2016 Images: 0');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    let img2016 = chosen2016.col.mean();

    // 3. Baseline 2001-2010: per-year means, each with fallback
    let baselineMeans = [];
    let baselineTotalImages = 0;
    let yearsUsed = 0;
    for (let y = 2001; y <= 2010; y++) {
      let s = `${y}-01-17`;
      let e = `${y}-01-25`;
      let chosen = await chooseColWithFallback(s, e, region);
      if (chosen.size > 0) {
        yearsUsed += 1;
        baselineTotalImages += chosen.size;
        baselineMeans.push(chosen.col.mean());
      }
    }
    if (yearsUsed === 0) {
      console.log('Baseline Years Used: 0/10');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    let baselineImg = ee.ImageCollection(baselineMeans).mean();

    // 4. Counts to detect C2
    let stats2016 = await regionStats(img2016, region);
    let statsBase = await regionStats(baselineImg, region);

    if ((stats2016.valid === 0) || (statsBase.valid === 0)) {
      console.log('No valid pixels after masking in one or both periods.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Validate means (C3 checks)
    const m2016 = stats2016.mean;
    const mBase = statsBase.mean;
    if (m2016 === null || mBase === null || isNaN(m2016) || isNaN(mBase)) {
      console.log('Mean is null/NaN for one of the periods.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if (!(m2016 > -80 && m2016 < 80 && mBase > -80 && mBase < 80)) {
      console.log('Mean out of plausible LST range.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 6. Print concise evidence
    console.log(`Region: Taipei 15km buffer; Scale: 1000m`);
    console.log(`2016 Product: ${chosen2016.id.split('/').pop()}, Images: ${chosen2016.size}`);
    console.log(`2016 Jan17-24 Mean LST (C): ${fmt(m2016)} | Valid: ${stats2016.valid}/${stats2016.total} (${fmt(stats2016.pct)}%)`);
    console.log(`Baseline Years Used: ${yearsUsed}/10 | Total Images: ${baselineTotalImages}`);
    console.log(`Baseline Jan17-24 Mean LST (C): ${fmt(mBase)} | Valid: ${statsBase.valid}/${statsBase.total} (${fmt(statsBase.pct)}%)`);
    console.log(`Delta (2016 - Baseline) (C): ${fmt(m2016 - mBase)}`);

    // 7. Final Answer
    if (m2016 < mBase) {
      console.log('A'); // Yes, decreased
    } else {
      console.log('B'); // No, did not decrease
    }

  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
